content_sections.heading: VNMKV Young Professional-I Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee.

rows.information: Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth, Parbhani - Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

content_sections.heading: About VNMKV
content_sections.text: Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth is the agricultural university based in Parbhani, Maharashtra. This post is at its Krishi Vigyan Kendra on Paithan Road, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (M.S) - 431010, which issued the notice through its Programme Co-ordinator. The post serves the project "Mission on Cotton Productivity: Dissemination of Cotton Technologies for enhancing cotton productivity and sustainability."

content_sections.heading: VNMKV Young Professional-I Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Travelling and Daily Allowance (TA/DA) for duty are paid as per project norms.

content_sections.heading: VNMKV Young Professional-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years. Age relaxation is as per rules. Graduate in Agriculture or Diploma in Agriculture. Only candidates holding the essential qualification will be entertained for the interview. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint) Experience in the same field A two-wheeler licence Employed candidates must bring a no objection certificate from their employer. For the full eligibility conditions, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview at Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Paithan Road, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, with verification of original documents on the same day. Candidates reaching after the specified time (09.00 AM to 10.00 AM) may not ordinarily be entertained. No T.A. or D.A. is paid for attending the interview, and the decision of the competent authority is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and contractual, initially up to 31 March 2027. It may be extended based on performance or till the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The service ends on completion of the project, and the selected candidate cannot claim permanency or seniority in KVK, the University or State Government. The Director of Research, VNMKV Parbhani, may terminate the contract even before the project ends, with no appeal. The selected candidate joins at Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Paithan Road, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. A bond on stamp paper must be executed as per university rule. On resigning, one month's prior notice is required, or one month's amount must be paid in lieu of notice. Concealing facts or canvassing in any form leads to disqualification or termination. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Court only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VNMKV Young Professional-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Print the application form given on page 3 of the official notification. Fill in your name, correspondence address, date of birth, mobile number, e-mail ID, educational qualifications, experience, extracurricular activities and publications, and paste a passport size photograph. Attach a xerox set of all documents and proofs to the form. Report on 6 November 2026 at 09:00 AM at Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Paithan Road, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, and submit the application. Documents to carry: Filled application form with photograph Biodata Xerox set of all documents and proofs All original documents for verification No objection certificate from the employer, if employed The KVK's e-mail address printed on the notice is [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the VNMKV Young Professional-I walk-in interview?
faq.answer: On 6 November 2026 at 09:00 AM at Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Paithan Road, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Candidates should report between 09.00 AM and 10.00 AM; those arriving later may not ordinarily be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. Can a Diploma holder in Agriculture apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The essential qualification is Graduate in Agriculture or Diploma in Agriculture.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a Young Professional-I at KVK Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar?
faq.answer: Rs. 30000 per month, fixed consolidated pay.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years, with relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. Which project is the post under?
faq.answer: Mission on Cotton Productivity: Dissemination of Cotton Technologies for enhancing cotton productivity and sustainability.

faq.question: Q7. How long will the contract last?
faq.answer: Initially up to 31 March 2027, extendable on performance or till the project ends, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the application form?
faq.answer: It is on page 3 of the official notification, with a box for a passport size photograph.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, T.A. and D.A. will not be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Does the selected candidate have to sign a bond?
faq.answer: Yes, a bond on stamp paper as per university rule.
